ASSIGNMENTOFRENTSANDLEASES THIS ASSIGNMENT, made this 28"h day of August, 2008, by 191$T Street Associates, LLC, having an office at c/o Intervest Development Corp., 1841 Broadway, 10"h Floor, Suite 1000, New York, New York 10023 (hereinafter called “Assignor") to NEW YORK COMMUNITY BANK, with an office at 1 Jericho Plaza, Third Floor, Jericho, New York, 11753 (hereinafter called “Assignee"). WITNESSETH: [A].  Assignor has executed, acknowledged and delivered to Assignee, Assignor's notes and obligations bearing even date herewith in the consolidated amount DOLLARS (the “Consolidated Note") performance of which is secured by a mortgage (the “Mortgage) together with a Consolidation, Extension and Modification Agreement (the“Agreement") bearing even date herewith covering certain real estate located in New York County, City and State of New York (the “Property"), more fully described in [B].  As additional security for performance of Assignor's obligations under the Consolidated Note, Agreement and Mortgage, Assignor has agreed to assign to Assignee all of Assignor's rights under leases affecting the Property, on the terms and conditions herein set forth. NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained herein, and other good and valuable consideration, receipt of which is hereby acknowledged,Assignor agrees as.follows: 1. Assignment of Leases Assignor hereby assigns and transfers to Assignee all of the Assignor's rights, interest, and privileges in all leases now or hereafter in existence with respect to the property or any part thereof, together with any extension or renewal of any such lease. This Assignment includes: (a) All rents, income and profits due or to become due under the leases, or any of them. (b) any sums to which Assignor may become entitled in any court proceeding involving the bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization of any tenant; and Without limitation of the foregoing, this Assignment includes Assignor's interest
